    (Logits presence_penalty freqency_penalty repetition_penalty : Region .real)

      repetition_penalty p_token_ids p_token_counts p_cumsum_seq_len
      stride_logit_b stride_logit_s BLOCK_P ≡[R]
    reciprocal Logits presence_penalty freqency_penalty
      repetition_penalty p_token_ids p_token_counts p_cumsum_seq_len
      stride_logit_b stride_logit_s BLOCK_P
declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete fp32 program equivalence under admitted div_mul_rcp inside the positive tl.where arm. Actual gathered logit lanes must be finite and the loaded repetition scalar finite and nonzero at the rewrite prefix, including evaluated masked lanes. Negative inputs are allowed; comparison, eager arm evaluation, count promotion, gather/scatter order, mask, full state and failure are preserved. Does not require distinct ids for contextual equality; no IEEE or performance claim.

proof_used_evidence.method: Existing complete acceptance StatementAudit instantiated proof traversal; exact entry identities checked by Probe.lean and source branch inspection

    (stride_logit_b stride_logit_s BLOCK_P : Nat) : Site :=

      repetition_penalty p_token_ids p_token_counts p_cumsum_seq_len
      stride_logit_b stride_logit_s BLOCK_P).surfaceBody

in_file_domain_definition_refs.name: interRequirements
in_file_domain_definition_refs.source:
def interRequirements (kernel : ComputeKernel) (BC BK : Nat) : List Site :=
  (do
    let outer ← Source.conditional? kernel.surfaceBody (fun code =>
      (Source.conditional? code (fun body => (Source.dynamicRange? body "i_k").isSome)).isSome)
    let inner ← Source.conditional? outer.yes (fun body => (Source.dynamicRange? body "i_k").isSome)
    let loop ← Source.dynamicRange? inner.yes "i_k"
    return Site.branch outer.before outer.condition Bool.true
      (.branch inner.before inner.condition Bool.true
        (.range loop.before "i_k" loop.start loop.stop loop.stride loop.body
          (.addFP32 (Source.prefixBefore loop.body "b_A") [BC,BC]
            (.ref .real [BC,BC] "b_A")
            (.dot (batch := []) (.ref .real [BC,BK] "b_qg") (.ref .real [BK,BC] "b_kg") {}))))).toList
section
variable (qs ks gs : TypedInter.Storage) (out : FloatDType) (q k g A : RegionName)
  (s_k_h s_k_t : Nat) (scale : ℝ) (T K BT BC BK NC : Nat)

  kernel := TypedInter.original qs ks gs out q k g A s_k_h s_k_t scale T K BT BC BK NC
  domain := interRequirements (TypedInter.original qs ks gs out q k g A s_k_h s_k_t scale T K BT BC BK NC) BC BK

    let loop ← Source.dynamicRange? active.yes "j"
    return Site.branch active.before active.condition Bool.true
      (.range loop.before "j" loop.start loop.stop loop.stride loop.body
        (.mulScalarFP32 (Source.prefixBefore loop.body "b_A" 1) BC []
          (.ref .real [BC] "b_A") (.const scale)))).toList
section
variable (qs ks gs : TypedIntra.Storage) (q k g A : RegionName)

def interRequirements (kernel : ComputeKernel) (BC BK : Nat) : List Site :=
  (do
    let outer ← Source.conditional? kernel.surfaceBody (fun code =>
      (Source.conditional? code (fun body => (Source.dynamicRange? body "i_k").isSome)).isSome)
    let inner ← Source.conditional? outer.yes (fun body => (Source.dynamicRange? body "i_k").isSome)
    let loop ← Source.dynamicRange? inner.yes "i_k"
    return Site.branch outer.before outer.condition Bool.true
      (.branch inner.before inner.condition Bool.true
        (.range loop.before "i_k" loop.start loop.stop loop.stride loop.body
          (.addFP32 (Source.prefixBefore loop.body "b_A") [BC,BC]
            (.ref .real [BC,BC] "b_A")
            (.dot (batch := []) (.ref .real [BC,BK] "b_qg") (.ref .real [BK,BC] "b_kg") {}))))).toList

  match Source.intRange? code "start_n" with
  | none => []
  | some loop => [.intRange loop.before "start_n" loop.start loop.stop loop.stride loop.body
      (match storage with
       | .fp16 | .bf16 => .mulScalarTypedFP32 (Source.prefixBefore loop.body "qk" 1) BM [BN]
           (.ref .fp32 [BM,BN] "qk") (.constFloat .fp32 scale)
       | .fp32 => .mulScalar (Source.prefixBefore loop.body "qk" 1) BM [BN]
           (.ref .real [BM,BN] "qk") (.const scale))]

declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete typed original/index-commuted program equivalence using exact Nat multiplication commutativity only in the lane mask. Empty atom list and domain; numerical operations, casts, loop order, reads, writes and failure remain unchanged. Real-valued abstract FP execution witnesses from empty registers use two iterations, nonzero program IDs and a partial lane. The witness is inhabited model execution, not physical GPU or IEEE behavior. All nine independent data/gate storage pairs, last_g branch, three stores, in-place gradients and final unused pointer decrements. The inhabited witness uses a local consistent abstract algebra with identity casts and constant-one unary operations; it is not numerical refinement. Both source programs retain the signed reverse loop, including the empty BT=0 case; this equivalence uses no Nat-reference premise.

specification actual_source_equivalence (input : Storage) (Q K V L O : RegionName) (sm_scale : ℝ)
    (stride_q_bs stride_q_head stride_q_seqlen stride_q_dim
      stride_k_bs stride_k_head stride_k_seqlen stride_k_dim
      stride_v_bs stride_v_head stride_v_seqlen stride_v_dim
      stride_o_bs stride_o_head stride_o_seqlen stride_o_dim
      BS HEAD SEQLEN BLOCK_M DIM BLOCK_N : Nat) (causal : Bool) :
    ActualFPProof.program Bool.false input Q K V L O sm_scale stride_q_bs stride_q_head stride_q_seqlen stride_q_dim
    stride_k_bs stride_k_head stride_k_seqlen stride_k_dim
    stride_v_bs stride_v_head stride_v_seqlen stride_v_dim
    stride_o_bs stride_o_head stride_o_seqlen stride_o_dim
    BS HEAD SEQLEN BLOCK_M DIM BLOCK_N causal ≡[assumptions]
    ActualFPProof.program Bool.true input Q K V L O sm_scale stride_q_bs stride_q_head stride_q_seqlen stride_q_dim
    stride_k_bs stride_k_head stride_k_seqlen stride_k_dim
    stride_v_bs stride_v_head stride_v_seqlen stride_v_dim
    stride_o_bs stride_o_head stride_o_seqlen stride_o_dim
    BS HEAD SEQLEN BLOCK_M DIM BLOCK_N causal
declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete exact-source original/candidate typed-state and failure equivalence for all symbolic dimensions/natural strides, both causal modes, every backend and initial state. Only the natural head-offset product commutes. The program domain and FP assumptions are empty; no finite-input or successful-output premise is required. The unmodified Python body retains every source stride and unused parameter, Q-head base reuse for Q/K/V/O, K sequence stride for V, decimal 1.44269504, complete rounded-up unchecked KV loads, causal masking, fp16 Q/probability casts, fp32 accumulators and the exact L-then-O stores. ActualPrecision independently checks Q load and scaling precision and both stores, including fp64 multiplication before fp16 conversion. Native dot requires fp16 K/V, and the final block store requires fp16 O; the wrapper empty_like(Q) therefore requires fp16 Q/O. Six floating Q labels are modeled for direct calls with fp16 O. The unchanged-source offline Triton 3.7.1/sm90 probe checked 12 admitted cases and 10 expected block-store dtype rejections, at one block shape and fp32 scalar scale. This compile evidence does not establish GPU arithmetic or every launch configuration. The named IO includes actual source trace safety, successful finite-flat execution, both independent initial-memory attention outputs, and the complete raw-cell frame, including unallocated addresses and unrelated dtypes. The formula includes every physically loaded padded key. The reference scatters L then O in source lane order, preserving arbitrary output aliasing. Positive block step/source stop, bounds for every unchecked read/write, allocation disjointness/closure and zero undef are explicit. Real arithmetic erases floating casts. Finite witnesses discharge allocation/access premises for nonzero head ID, noncontiguous strides and SEQLEN=3/BLOCK_N=2; padding V=4 makes noncausal O=1 and L=2. Separate complete typed exact-source executions prove both variants and causal modes, causal O/L=0/0 with second-row L=1, noncausal O/L=1/2 and a raw frame outside all six store addresses. The real numerical backend uses actual dot/reduction/exp2/log2 and identity casts; it is nonvacuity evidence, not IEEE evidence. Direct-call integer/bool Q conversions, other runtime scale profiles, negative strides, native integer-width overflow, general native shape/target admission, host allocation validity, grid coverage, concurrent races and IEEE/device numerical behavior remain unverified. Independent comparator replay is pending. This scoped record is not full-port acceptance.

def additionSite (x b i : RegionName) (W N B : Nat) (m : ℝ) (a : Bool) : Site :=
  .add (Source.prefixBefore
    (fused_add_mul_activation_kernel x b i W N B m a).surfaceBody "activ_input")
    [B] (.add .real (.consSame .nil)
      (.mul .real .scalarL (.const m) (.ref .real [B] "tmp3"))
      (.ref .real [B] "tmp0")) (.ref .real [B] "tmp1")

specification backward_index_equiv (storage partner gradient : Storage)
    (dc a b : RegionName) (stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE : Nat) :
    backward storage partner gradient Bool.false dc a b stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE ≡[assumptions]
      backward storage partner gradient Bool.true dc a b stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE
declarations.reviewed_scope: 216 independent A/B/DC storage combinations. Storage formats: fp32, fp16, bf16, fp64, fp8e4nv, fp8e5. Complete original/candidate typed state, memory and failure equality with no numerical atoms or domain conditions. Only signed Int row-base products commute before conversion to natural pointer offsets. The source decimal scale 0.7978845608028654 is retained exactly; the literal-only 3*0.044715 product folds to 0.134145 before fp32 conversion, with both following tensor multiplications retained. Python imported tanh is explicitly libdevice.tanh, with fp32 argument computation, actual mixed-type promotion, local precision scopes and storage conversions. This proves the written backward expression, not an analytic derivative theorem. Other storage formats, host launch/shape/allocation checks, negative strides, fixed-width address overflow and target-specific fp8 support are outside scope. Nonempty typed witnesses use exact-real arithmetic, not IEEE rounding. Independent comparator replay pending.

Full 155 repetition was stopped and is not counted as passed.
review_basis.proof_walker_changes: Only output changed to rule_id+instance_key; Boolean constructors qualified to avoid imported DSL keywords.
review_basis.existing_build_crosscheck: 154 of 155 concise per-declaration outputs matched complete acceptance log. seeded_dropout omitted the print command, so queried directly; exact instance keys are identified by fixed entry definitions, fresh Lean evaluation, and context storage branches; a redundant all-155 fresh query was stopped to avoid repeating expensive traversals.

declarations.statement_source:
specification source_equivalence (x y output : Storage)
    (_hSource : sourceSupported x y = Bool.true)
    (X Y O : RegionName) (N B : Nat) :
    program x y output Bool.false X Y O N B ≡[assumptions]
      program x y output Bool.true X Y O N B
declarations.reviewed_scope: 192 source-supported independent floating X/Y/output triples, both complete eight-statement source variants; all masked loads retain missing-other behavior. Candidate commutes only the natural block-index multiplication. Full state/memory/failure equality for arbitrary initial states, aliases and block sizes, without numerical FP assumptions. Exact load AST checks cover 216 formal triples; exact arithmetic/store checks cover the 192 source-supported triples in both variants. The four both-fp8 input pairs are excluded by the pinned frontend logarithm type restriction, not by an observed GPU compilation. The mixed fp64/fp16/bf16 nonempty execution witness uses exact-real backend arithmetic and is not an IEEE rounding certificate. Real logarithm/division are totalized; ordinary finite KL interpretation requires positive inputs. Native lowering, discrete/mixed conversion coverage, host launch and cross-program scheduling remain unproved. Independent comparator replay pending.

specification backward_default_equivalence (target output : Storage)
    (T O : RegionName) (st so N B : Nat) (_hSource : BackwardSourceSupported target output Bool.false) :
    backward_default_program target output Bool.false T O st so N B ≡[assumptions]
      backward_default_program target output Bool.true T O st so N B
declarations.reviewed_scope: Full default backward source/candidate equivalence for 24 frontend-supported target/output pairs, preserving the exact weak scalar -1, original pre-loop assignments and every masked loop store. The candidate commutes only the signed output-row address product. Every floating expression, cast, loop, mask and store remains; complete state, memory and failure results are equal for every backend algebra, initial state and alias pattern, with no numerical assumptions or successful-execution premise. Source-domain predicates distinguish frontend-admitted profiles from the broader formal AST family. Exact precision trees check loads, runtime-fp32 epsilon, clamp/log/exp/subtract/multiply, elementwise store, reduction/carry and final scalar conversion. Native-device lowering, bit-accurate IEEE execution and independent comparator replay remain pending; indices are unbounded integers with natural strides.

specification source_equivalence (fp8 : Bool) (A W1 W3 OUT RMS : RegionName)
    (M N K sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n soutm soutn srms BM BN BK : Nat) (EPS : ℝ) :
    program fp8 Bool.false A W1 W3 OUT RMS M N K sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n soutm soutn srms BM BN BK EPS ≡[assumptions]
      program fp8 Bool.true A W1 W3 OUT RMS M N K sam sak sw1k sw1n sw3k sw3n soutm soutn srms BM BN BK EPS
declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete original/candidate typed-source equivalence in both weight arms for arbitrary dimensions, natural strides, every initial state and every backend algebra. Only the exact natural output-row index product is commuted; all floating operations, byte decodes, loops, loads and stores are unchanged. Entire state, memory and failure results agree. The FP assumption list and program domain are empty; finite-byte or execution-success premises are not required, and all signed-byte patterns remain represented. The wrapper fixes A/output to fp16, equal W1/W3/RMS storage to fp16 or signed int8, BM=BN=16, BK=64 and EPS=1e-6. It does not ensure K divisibility or sufficient RMS/padded allocation. The general source theorem covers natural strides; negative strides, fixed-width index overflow, cross-program races, native IEEE conformance, host composition and independent comparator replay remain outside the checked scope. No full-port acceptance is claimed.

in_file_domain_definition_refs.name: additionSite
in_file_domain_definition_refs.source:
def additionSite (storage : MaskStorage) (grad p mask : RegionName)
    (n : Nat) (alpha : ℝ) (B : Nat) : Site :=
  .addFP32 (Source.prefixBefore
    (integer_kernel storage Bool.false grad p mask n alpha B).surfaceBody "grad" 1) [B]
    (.ref .real [B] "grad")
    (.mul .real .scalarR (.ref .real [B] "p") (.castFloat .real .real (.const alpha)))

in_file_domain_definition_refs.name: original
in_file_domain_definition_refs.source:
def original (storage : MaskStorage) (grad p mask : RegionName)
    (n : Nat) (alpha : ℝ) (B : Nat) : Program where
  kernel := integer_kernel storage Bool.false grad p mask n alpha B
  domain := [additionSite storage grad p mask n alpha B]

in_file_domain_definition_refs.name: typedAdditionSite
in_file_domain_definition_refs.source:
def typedAdditionSite (gt pt : FloatStorage) (mt : MaskStorage) (g p m : RegionName)
    (n : Nat) (a : ℝ) (B : Nat) : Site :=
  .addFP32 (Source.prefixBefore
    (typed_integer_kernel gt pt mt Bool.false g p m n a B).surfaceBody "grad" 1) [B]
    (storedOperand gt "grad" B)
    (.mul .real .scalarR (storedOperand pt "p" B) (.castFloat .real .real (.const a)))

in_file_domain_definition_refs.name: typedOriginal
in_file_domain_definition_refs.source:
def typedOriginal (gt pt : FloatStorage) (mt : MaskStorage) (g p m : RegionName)
    (n : Nat) (a : ℝ) (B : Nat) : Program where
  kernel := typed_integer_kernel gt pt mt Bool.false g p m n a B
  domain := [typedAdditionSite gt pt mt g p m n a B]

in_file_domain_definition_refs.name: boolOriginal
in_file_domain_definition_refs.source:
def boolOriginal (grad p mask : RegionName) (n : Nat) (alpha : ℝ) (B : Nat) : Program where
  kernel := masked_add_kernel grad p mask n alpha B
  domain := [.add (Source.prefixBefore
    (masked_add_kernel grad p mask n alpha B).surfaceBody "grad" 1) [B]
    (.ref .real [B] "grad")
    (.mul .real .scalarR (.ref .real [B] "p") (.const alpha))]

Separate source-mapped signed-i32 control/coordinate/offset agreement is proved under an explicit arithmetic domain, with nonempty witnesses for both recorded profiles. Reached cached-coordinate promises hold exactly when BM divides M and BN divides N for positive K; any M/N remainder gives an actual reached contiguity counterexample in that projection. These helpers do not narrow the public mathematical contract or establish full typed-source/TTIR refinement, arbitrary native configuration admission, physical pointer provenance or compiler soundness. The reviewed 174-port candidate passes the selected dtype-attribute source comparison; this is not all-profile source certification. Native IEEE/GPU numerics, concurrent interleaving semantics and official independent comparator replay are not established. This is scoped formal coverage, not complete original-Triton-port acceptance.

      dimensionProgram storage Bool.true inp ov oi M N K BM BN
declarations.reviewed_scope: Six floating storage profiles: fp32, fp16, bf16, fp8e4nv, fp8e5 and fp64. Complete original/candidate state, memory and failure equality, with no numerical atoms or domain conditions. Only exact natural address products or the reversed natural mask bound change. Ordinary max promotes half/bfloat/fp8 to fp32; indexed max promotes bf16 and otherwise retains storage precision. Indexed value and index share one paired backend and default leftmost tie policy. Per-program scope; host launch, two-pass composition, target-specific GPU dtype acceptance, integer/bool inputs and fixed-width address validity are outside scope. Numerical typed witnesses use exact-real arithmetic, not IEEE rounding. Independent comparator replay pending.

declarations.statement_source:
specification floating_source_equivalence (output : TypedSource.FloatingOutput)
    (oneTile : Bool) (base : ℝ) (X Y : RegionName) (sx sy N tasks tiles B : Nat) :
    program output oneTile Bool.false base X Y sx sy N tasks tiles B ≡[assumptions]
      program output oneTile Bool.true base X Y sx sy N tasks tiles B
declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete original/candidate typed-state and failure equivalence for both floating-exponent branches, six destinations, arbitrary parameters, backends and initial states. The program domain and FP assumption list are empty; only the natural tile-offset multiplication changes. Both complete source branches retain the unused cdiv/num_tasks, dynamic grid-stride traversal, actual axis-0 boundary checks, unspecified load padding, explicit fp32 base conversion and source output-element conversion. Candidate only commutes the natural tile offset product. Six floating output labels yield 24 templates per exponent family. Independent typed precision assertions check native power dispatch and all conversions. Pinned native extern lookup accepts fp32 exponent via __nv_powf and int32 via __nv_powif; the production dispatcher rejects thirteen other exponent labels before promotion. This dispatch evidence is not full native compilation or numerical validation. The wrapper explicitly permits signed strides and shifted base pointers; negative strides remain unverified because current block-pointer strides are Nat. Integer runtime scalar-to-fp32 conversion and nonfloating output conversion are also unverified. Native fixed-width overflow, libdevice/IEEE accuracy, physical packing, host allocation validity, whole-grid composition and races remain outside these proofs. Independent comparator replay is pending; these records do not claim full-port acceptance.

specification source_equivalence (q k cos sin : Storage) (Q K Cos Sin : RegionName)
    (sqb sqh sqd skb skh skd scb scd ssb ssd L HQ HK BH BS D : Nat) :
    program q k cos sin Bool.false Q K Cos Sin sqb sqh sqd skb skh skd scb scd ssb ssd

    program q k cos sin Bool.true Q K Cos Sin sqb sqh sqd skb skh skd scb scd ssb ssd
      L HQ HK BH BS D
declarations.reviewed_scope: Complete typed-source equivalence for independent Q/K/Cos/Sin storage labels, all symbolic natural parameters, every initial state and every backend algebra. Only the exact natural head-base multiplication is commuted; floating arithmetic, promotions, masks, loads and all four stores are unchanged. Entire state, memory and failure results agree, with an empty domain and no FP assumptions. It does not require the real formula domain or claim a numerical rewrite. Storage templates are structural interpreter coverage, not native frontend admission. The recorded offline Triton 3.7.1/sm90 homogeneous fp32/fp64/fp16/bf16 lowerings succeed; homogeneous fp8e4nv/fp8e5 fail LLVM lowering, and mixed-storage admission is not established. This is not pinned-3.5.1 evidence or GPU execution. Natural strides, source-mask bounds and symbolic block dimensions do not establish signed-stride support, fixed-width overflow safety or native arange/launch validity. The host grid uses HEAD_Q, so extra K heads may be uncovered. Cross-program races, host composition, native IEEE conformance and independent comparator replay remain outside the checked scope. No full-port acceptance is claimed.

Mathematical Int addresses do not model machine wraparound or native negative-pointer validity. Native launch constraints, host wrapper, GPU scheduling and code generation remain outside scope. declarations.statement_source:
specification backward_index_equiv (storage partner gradient : Storage)
    (dc a b : RegionName) (stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE : Nat) :
    backward storage partner gradient Bool.false dc a b stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE ≡[assumptions]
      backward storage partner gradient Bool.true dc a b stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE
declarations.reviewed_scope: 216 independent A/B/DC storage combinations. Storage formats: fp32, fp16, bf16, fp64, fp8e4nv, fp8e5. Complete original/candidate typed state, memory and failure equality with no numerical atoms or domain conditions. Only signed Int row-base products commute before conversion to natural pointer offsets. The helper silu is a*sigmoid(a), computed in fp32. B and DC retain their raw storage, backward preserves ((dc*factor)*b), and exact AST regressions protect mixed fp64 local precision and output conversion. This proves the written backward expression, not an analytic derivative theorem. Other storage formats, host launch/shape/allocation checks, negative strides, fixed-width address overflow and target-specific fp8 support are outside scope. Nonempty typed witnesses use exact-real arithmetic, not IEEE rounding. Independent comparator replay pending.

native_boundaries.formula: NumericDType add/sub/mul/div on all floating tags use Option.map₂ of exact ℝ operations; FloatDType.cast preserves WithBot ℝ through dtype tags.
native_boundaries.effect: The 429 mathematical statements are formal real-model results, not exact GPU floating results. Do not turn every such result into a new missing experiment; retain a separate semantics/refinement axis.

formula: realPow (some a) (some b) = some (Real.rpow a b)
native_boundaries.effect: These are definitions of the mathematical model, not unproved exp/log/sqrt laws in the reviewed signatures. Approximation errors, exceptional IEEE inputs, fast-math and instruction correspondence need a separate hardware refinement study.

native_boundaries.formula: realToInt8 (some x) = if 0 ≤ x then Int.floor x else -Int.floor (-x); tritonInt8CastInRange x := -128 ≤ trunc(x) ∧ trunc(x) ≤ 127
native_boundaries.effect: The value model uses unbounded Int after truncation. Width overflow/saturation/wraparound must be scoped separately; do not call a pre-rounding/scaled-store theorem a completed int8 conversion proof.

hPrev/hNext and prepared KTrans/VTile refer to a declared local stage input. User accepts stage scope. In particular fused_recurrent_delta hNext is a supplied post-update carry and not discharged merely by an adjacent state-update clause; do not promote the stage theorem to end-to-end.

native_boundaries.formula: s.undef = (fun _ _ => 0), or ∀ rg off, s.undef rg off = 0
native_boundaries.effect: 50 public statement texts mention an undef condition. Some are the finite-flat bridge convention, some select a zero oracle for masked/boundary loads. This is not an addition/rounding experiment. For hardware use preserve the zero-oracle profile or separately show undefined lanes are unobserved; no blanket arbitrary-undef claim is made. This textual count excludes conditions hidden only inside named IO definitions.

native_boundaries: Existing scalar reports are trusted scoped empirical evidence. They are not new GPU replay or universal IEEE equalities. A separate backend refinement is required for a hardware-wide claim.
RoundingModel requires round_real and round_idem in the actual structure. Its introductory comment is stale about optional idempotence; the structure fields are authoritative.
Normal input and documented configuration/stage scopes are accepted by the user. This does not change the formulas, omit eager-lane guards, or silently prove omitted source stages.
interpretation: Accepted input/configuration/stage scope does not accept replacement of floating arithmetic by real arithmetic. FP model adequacy is the primary axis; absence of extra numerical laws is only a subordinate syntactic/evidence count. A backend-equivalence record proves candidate-vs-original behavior under its stated model, not absolute native functional correctness or coverage of every other public claim in that task. Existing reports remain scoped empirical premises. No experiment is executed or admitted by this inventory.
